Questions or a tour?

020 – 423 39 30 info@huizefrankendael.nl

This website is built to process as little of your data as possible.

What this website does not do

  • No cookies or similar techniques; hence no cookie banner either.
  • No analytics or other third-party trackers.
  • No contact forms: you get in touch yourself by email or phone.

What does happen

  • If you email info@huizefrankendael.nl or call, we process the information you share yourself (name, contact details, the content of your message) to answer your enquiry and handle a reservation or proposal. [RETENTION PERIOD TO CONFIRM — e.g. at most 2 years after last contact.]
  • The website’s hosting provider processes brief technical log files (such as IP address and time) to keep the site secure and available. [HOSTING PROVIDER TO CONFIRM.]
  • Reservations at restaurant Merkelbach happen on the Zenchef reservation page, which only opens after you click it; Zenchef’s and the restaurant’s privacy policies apply there.
  • Links to external services (Google Maps, Instagram, Facebook, the newsletter environment) only open after you click them.

Your rights

You have the right to access, correct and delete your personal data. Contact info@huizefrankendael.nl to do so. Complaints can be filed with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

Controller
